transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just can’t seem to keep my mind on things the way I used to. I'm a loan officer, and lately... I'll just sit and stare at a loan worksheet or my client follow-up list, and I end up rereading the same line over and over again. Then I just put off making the calls, because honestly, even simple decisions are starting to feel a lot harder than they should.
Aside from these concentration difficulties, how has your mood been lately?

Well, mostly it's just been... low. Most days there's this dull heaviness sitting with me. I still try to do things, like going to the community center or working out in my garden. Those are places that really used to lift me up, but now... I don't know, I just feel like I'm going through the motions. I'm there, and I have a smile pasted on, but that heavy feeling doesn't really go away.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been a while now. I'd say... a little over two years. This has all been going on since my close friend died, and the feeling just hasn't really lifted since then.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of two months or more where you felt like your normal self?
No... no, I don't think so. I really haven't had a break for that long. It's pretty much just been this same heavy feeling the whole time.
How have your energy levels been throughout this time?

Honestly, my energy is just... pretty low. I wake up tired even after I've had a full night of sleep. And by the time I’ve done a couple of client calls for work, or just gone out to water the tomatoes, my body feels like I’ve put in a whole day already. I'm just worn out very quickly.
Before this started two years ago, had you ever experienced periods of depression like this in your life?
No, I haven't. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... no, nothing like this. Before my friend passed away, I was generally doing fine. This is really the first time in my life I've ever felt this way.
During this time, have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?

No, not really. I mean, I feel sad and tired, but I don't feel like I'm worthless or anything like that. And I don't really have anything to feel guilty about. It's just... this constant low mood, not really guilt.
